data.long_description:
Provident is pleased to present this exceptional 4-bedroom + maid’s room villa, offering a refined living experience with contemporary design and premium finishes. With a spacious layout, upgraded interiors, and an abundance of natural light, this residence is crafted for those seeking both comfort and sophistication. Whether relaxing in the expansive living areas or making use of the world-class amenities, Sidra Villas delivers a lifestyle of modern luxury.

Property Features:

-4 Bedrooms + Maid’s Room
-Floor-to-ceiling windows
-Built-in wardrobes
-4,655.82 sq. ft
-Balcony
-Bright and naturally lit throughout
-Fully fitted wooden kitchen
-Marble flooring

Community Amenities:

-Swimming pools, gyms & children’s play areas
-Cycling and jogging tracks
-Large Central Park and Dubai Hills Mall nearby
-Minutes from Dubai Hills Golf Club
-Close to top-rated schools and healthcare facilities
-Easy access to Downtown Dubai (15 mins) and Dubai Marina (20 mins)

Location:

Sidra Villas – Dubai Hills Estate
Modern 3–5 bedroom villas by Emaar, featuring elegant layouts, private gardens, and top-tier amenities. A prime family-friendly community with excellent connectivity and lifestyle offerings.
